snippet.title: Darkhaven Gameplay Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Darkhaven is a new dark-fantasy ARPG set in the ruins of a dying world. To survive, you must venture into an unforgiving, ever-changing world, loot ancient relics of legendary power, and become the hero this world needs.

It's being built by Moon Beast Productions, Run by legendary Developers Phil Shenk, Peter Hu, Erich Schaefer, Brian Bazyk, Colin Day, Brian Frizgerald, Eric McNine, and Anthony Rivero! 

Join our community Discord here: https://discord.gg/moonbeast

Steam Wish List: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3571870/Darkhaven/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=demo_launch&utm_content=

Kick starter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/moonbeastproductions/darkhaven-an-action-rpg-with-dynamic-worlds?ref=8bjtks.

Sign Up for the Moonbeast Newsletter here: https://www.moonbeast.com/

#Darkhaven #arpg #moonbeast
